parameters.content:
## AGENT 8: CREATOR OUTREACH

3 entry points:
1. POST /outreach-creators — Batch email outreach to creators
2. Schedule 10AM IST — Auto follow-up stale contacts (3+ days)
3. POST /creator-reply — Handle incoming creator replies

Airtable: Creators table (tbl59nWGcoucE0gjf)
Gemini 2.5 Flash for email drafting
Gmail API for sending emails
Slack notifications to ugc-agent-notifications

## PATH 1: OUTREACH
Webhook → Fetch Creators → Filter → Gemini Draft → Build Gmail Payload → Send Email → Update Airtable → Aggregate → Slack + Event + Respond

## PATH 2: AUTO FOLLOW-UP
Schedule 10AM IST → Fetch Contacted → Filter 3+ days → Gemini Draft Follow-up → Send → Update → Slack

## PATH 3: HANDLE REPLY
Webhook → Fetch Creator → Update Status → Gemini Portfolio Check → Update Qualified → Slack + Respond

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (() => { const data = $input.first().json; const creators = data.creators; const params = data.params; const prompt = 'Draft personalized outreach emails for each creator below. You are writing on behalf of Smashed Agency, a UGC (User-Generated Content) creative agency.

CAMPAIGN DETAILS:
- Brand/Niche: ' + (params.niche || params.brand || 'UGC content') + '
- Budget per video: INR ' + (params.budget || 'negotiable') + '
- Looking for UGC creators for brand campaigns
' + (params.template ? '
USE THIS TEMPLATE AS BASE:
' + params.template + '
' : '') + '
CREATORS:
' + creators.map((c, i) => (i+1) + '. Name: ' + c.name + ', Email: ' + c.email + ', IG: ' + c.instagram_handle + ', Niches: ' + c.niches.join(', ') + ', Rate: INR ' + (c.rate || 'unknown') + ', Location: ' + c.location).join('
') + '

For each creator, write:
1. A personalized subject line (short, compelling)
2. A professional but warm email body (3-4 paragraphs max)
   - Reference their specific niche/content style
   - Mention the campaign opportunity
   - Include budget range
   - Ask them to reply with their portfolio/rate card
   - Sign off as Team Smashed Agency

Return ONLY valid JSON array:
[{"email": "email@example.com", "name": "Name", "subject": "Subject line", "body": "Full email body"}]'; return JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are a professional talent outreach AI for Smashed Agency. Write compelling, personalized creator outreach emails. Return only valid JSON array. No markdown fences.' }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.7, maxOutputTokens: 8000 } }); })() }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ fields: { status: 'Active', notes: 'Outreach email sent on ' + new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0] + ' | Subject: ' + ($json.subject || 'Outreach') } }) }}

parameters.text:
={{ '*Creator Outreach Report*

Emails sent: ' + $json.sent + '/' + $json.total + '
Failed: ' + $json.failed + '

' + ($json.details || []).map(function(d) { return (d.success ? 'Sent' : 'FAILED') + ': ' + d.name + ' (' + d.email + ')'; }).join('
') + '

_' + $json.timestamp + '_' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, sent: $json.sent, failed: $json.failed, total: $json.total, details: $json.details }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: 'creator_outreach', event_type: 'creator_outreach_sent', brand_name: '', client_code: '', severity: 'info', message: 'Outreach emails sent to ' + $json.sent + ' creators (' + $json.failed + ' failed)', payload: JSON.stringify({ total: $json.total, sent: $json.sent, failed: $json.failed }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $json.error || 'No creators found matching criteria', params: $json.params }) }}

' + creators.map((c, i) => (i+1) + '. Name: ' + c.name + ', Email: ' + c.email + ', IG: ' + c.instagram_handle + ', Niches: ' + c.niches.join(', ') + ', Days since first email: ' + c.days_since).join('
') + '

Return ONLY valid JSON array:
[{"email": "email@example.com", "name": "Name", "subject": "Re: Subject", "body": "Follow-up email body"}]'; return JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: 'You are a professional follow-up email writer for Smashed Agency. Write short, friendly follow-up emails. Return only valid JSON array. No markdown fences.' }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.6, maxOutputTokens: 4000 } }); })() }}
